2609.00629.title: ExpArt-KG: Artwork Image Description Generation through Iterative Exploration of Knowledge Graphs
2609.00629.paper_summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance on image-grounded text generation and visual question answering. However, it remains difficult for them to comprehensively and accurately describe the factual relations among the entities and concepts associated with the objects depicted in an image. In this work, we propose a framework that efficiently exploits factual information from a knowledge graph via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), with the goal of enabling LVLMs to generate detailed and accurate image explanations. Specifically, our method alternates between answer generation and knowledge-graph retrieval, and controls the search using a correctness judgment, thereby acquiring the necessary and sufficient factual information efficiently. We also construct a knowledge graph for the artwork domain (ExpArt-KG), in which the correspondence between images and entities is unambiguous. Applying the proposed method to this knowledge graph, we show experimentally that it improves the level of detail of artwork explanations and reduces the retrieval cost of external knowledge while maintaining generation quality comparable to that of iterating a fixed number of times.
2609.00629.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺語言模型（LVLMs）在基於圖像的文本生成和視覺問題回答上表現出色。<lb/>然而，對於它們來說，全面且準確地描述與圖像中物體相關的實體和概念之間的事實關係仍然困難。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一個框架，通過檢索增強生成（RAG）有效利用知識圖譜中的事實信息，目標是使LVLMs能夠生成詳細且準確的圖像解釋。<lb/>具體而言，我們的方法在答案生成和知識圖譜檢索之間交替進行，並通過正確性判斷來控制搜索，從而有效獲取必要且充分的事實信息。<lb/>我們還為藝術作品領域構建了一個知識圖譜（ExpArt-KG），其中圖像與實體之間的對應關係是明確的。<lb/>將所提出的方法應用於這個知識圖譜，我們實驗性地顯示它提高了藝術作品解釋的細節水平，並降低了外部知識的檢索成本，同時保持生成質量與固定次數迭代的情況相當。
